name: Halle (Westfalen, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Halle (Westfalen) (white lilies and a chevron on red).
history: The design was adopted unchanged after the municipal reorganisation; the city flag is red-white-red striped with the arms.

features.role: Halle arms — lilies and chevron on red
